correctness.rationale: The source planar graph gives \(e=v_{\mathrm{bd}}+v_{\mathrm{int}}+t-1\) and \(2e=3t+v_{\mathrm{int}}^*+v_{\mathrm{bd}}\), hence \(t+2=v_{\mathrm{bd}}+2v_{\mathrm{int}}-v_{\mathrm{int}}^*\). Retaining size-two stretches, each such stretch contributes one full shared side and no subdividing vertex; a size-\(s\ge3\) stretch contributes \(s-2\) subdividing vertices. Equating the two exact counts of total nonboundary tile-side incidences yields \(q=v_{\mathrm{bd}}-3+3(v_{\mathrm{int}}-v_{\mathrm{int}}^*)+E\). The inequalities and equality criterion follow because both defect terms are nonnegative.
residual_risks: The proof is finite and planar and uses convex boundary accounting; it does not cover infinite or nonconvex tilings.
